entities.name: Theodor Höijer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Theodor Höijer was a Finnish architect. He designed a large number of buildings in central Helsinki. He was the first architect in Finland who managed to pursue a truly successful career without holding an official office. He has been described as the foremost architect working in Neo-Renaissance style in Finland.
